policy: Every public statistic must identify its source, definition, review date and whether BRASA independently verified it.

statistics.label: discoverable courses
statistics.definition: Courses reported in the Class Central discovery catalog; BRASA does not host or operate all of them.

statistics.label: universities and institutions
statistics.definition: The sum of Class Central's separately reported 1,300+ universities and 1,700+ institutions; categories may overlap, so BRASA displays them together only with this qualification.
statistics.qualification: May contain overlap between provider categories.

statistics.label: subjects
statistics.definition: Subjects in the Class Central subject directory.

statistics.label: README documentation languages
statistics.definition: English plus 88 localized repository README files. This does not mean every course or interface is available in every language.
